references.sentence: Our proposed approach features a digital IF modulator, as shown in Fig. 10.1.1 [3].
The measured DAC output spectrum (from dc to 1GHz) for a fullscale single-tone sine wave, at the output of the IFVGA, is shown in Fig. 10.1.3.
The RFVGA is a two-stage (cascode and common-emitter) design shown in Fig. 10.1.4.
The RFVGA linearity is also improved as shown in Fig. 10.1.5.
Fabricated in IBM’s 0.25µm SiGe BiCMOS process, the TxIC chip is shown in Fig. 10.1.7.
The TxIC current consumption, as well as some key measured results, are shown in Fig. 10.1.6.
